verdict.rationale: Galileo's official MCP server lets AI IDEs such as Cursor and VS Code with Copilot drive core operations through natural-language prompts: creating and managing datasets, running experiments, and setting up prompt templates. In-product natural-language support is narrower: an AI Assistant for troubleshooting agentic systems, and natural-language feedback that tunes metrics. Missing for 10: a general in-product natural-language command interface (operation in plain language mostly depends on an external IDE agent via MCP), documented scope of the AI Assistant beyond troubleshooting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
